e.t: A patent score you can trace all the way to the number.

e.b: A score, an SABCD grade, and where the patent ranks in the full 1433-patent pool — at a glance.
e.zb: 分數、SABCD 等級，以及在全 1433 件專利池中的排名 — 一目了然。

e.b: The full seven-chapter report — patent facts, the 8-pillar radar, all 50 indicators, cross-scenario stability, and licensing-strategy guidance.
e.zb: 完整七章報告 — 專利基本資料、八大支柱雷達、50 項指標、跨方案穩定性，與授權策略建議。

e.b: The ten most relevant patents on the market, each with a similarity score and why it matches — retrieved by vector search, alongside your own patent's SABCD grade.
e.zb: 市場上最相關的十件專利，附相似度分數與比對原因，透過向量檢索取得，並附上你自己專利的 SABCD 等級。

e.b: 50 indicators, eight pillars, one 0–100 score, and a grade from S to D. Every step traces back to a number you can check.
e.zb: 50 項指標、八大支柱、一個 0–100 分的總分，以及 S 到 D 的評級。每一步都能追溯回一個可查核的數字。

e.b: 50 indicators are computed for every patent. Most are calculated from the patent record: citations, family, claims, dates, legal status. The rest are graded by closed-database AI tools reading the patent text.
e.zb: 每件專利都會計算 50 項指標。多數由專利紀錄計算 — 引用、家族、請求項、日期、法律狀態。其餘由封閉資料庫的 AI 工具閱讀專利文本後評分。

e.b: Indicators aggregate into eight pillars. Each pillar rolls up its own indicators as a weighted average, and the pillars are then weighted independently of each other.
e.zb: 指標會聚合為八大支柱。每根支柱以加權平均彙整旗下指標的分數，支柱之間再各自獨立加權。

e.b: A score is a position, so it needs a set to hold a position in. Your patent is ranked against 1433 patents held by TIS and its partners, patents we also license commercially.
e.zb: 分數是一個位置，所以它需要一個可以站定位置的集合。你的專利是拿來跟 1433 件由泰然與夥伴所持有的專利比較排名 — 這些專利我們同時也在做商業授權。

e.t: A raw value becomes a position
e.b: Every indicator is normalised the same way: rank the raw value inside the pool, take its percentile. A patent with 47 forward citations is not scored on 47. It is scored on where 47 falls among 1433.
e.zb: 每一項指標都以同一種方式正規化：把原始值拿到池內排名，取它的百分位。一件被前向引用 47 次的專利，分數不是 47，而是 47 在 1433 件之中的落點。

e.b: The weighted pillar scores compose into one PSS on a 0–100 scale, and that score's percentile in the pool resolves to one of five grades.
e.zb: 加權後的支柱分數合成為一個 0–100 分的 PSS 總分，這個總分在池內的百分位再對應到五個評級之一。

e.t: The same patent, weighted four ways
e.b: Pillar weights are not fixed. The same 50 indicators can be reweighted for the question you are actually asking, licensing, litigation, M&A, or portfolio strategy, and the patent gets a score under each.
e.zb: 支柱權重並非固定。同一組 50 項指標可以依你實際要回答的問題重新配權 — 授權導向、訴訟強度、投資併購、技術布局 — 並在每一套權重下各得一個分數。

e.b: Snapshot and Study are both built on this scoring. Survey answers a different question, the ten closest patents on the market, and does not compute a PSS.
e.zt: 這套方法產出兩種報告。
e.zb: 特寫與景深都建立在這套評分之上。廣角回答的是另一個問題 — 市場上最相近的十件專利 — 不使用 PSS。

e.b: From one patent to a whole portfolio, tell us what you need.
e.zb: 從一件專利到整個專利組合，告訴我們你的需求。

e.b: A score, an SABCD grade, and where the patent ranks in the full 1433-patent pool — at a glance.
e.zb: 分數、SABCD 等級，以及在全 1433 件專利池中的排名 — 一目了然。

e.b: The full seven-chapter report — patent facts, the 8-pillar radar, all 50 indicators, cross-scenario stability, and licensing-strategy guidance.
e.zb: 完整七章報告 — 專利基本資料、八大支柱雷達、50 項指標、跨方案穩定性，與授權策略建議。

e.t: Patent licences for your exports. Thirty patents, none of the overhead.
e.b: Pick country × industry × term — two paths, five SABCD grades. A Verified License Badge lets buyers check your licence on record.
e.zt: 為出口備妥專利授權， 30 件專利包輕裝上陣。
e.zb: 1 分鐘勾選國家 × 產業 × 期別，2 種專利包選法，5 類專利評級，授權認證標章讓買家查得到你的授權紀錄。

e.b: Scans gaps across your industry × export country and suggests the 30 relevant patents, with manual swaps supported — no legal expertise required.
e.zb: 依出口國 × 產業別 × 產品線三軸掃描風險缺口，推薦最相關的 30 件專利。支援人機協作與手動替換，不需懂法律。

e.b: III , iPIC , and NYCU stand behind a non-exclusive licence to 30 patents, issued to your company — institution-backed, and recognized by buyers and partners.
e.zb: 創智、資策會、陽明交大作為授權方，提供以貴公司名義簽發、涵蓋 30 件專利的非專屬授權。在國際買家與合作夥伴面前，是機構級的 IP 後盾。

e.b: Patent-assertion claims tend to find companies with no licence on record. Three institutions behind your licence put one on record .
e.zb: 專利主張多半找上毫無授權紀錄的公司。三家機構為你的授權背書，授權紀錄不再是空白。

e.t: Issued once the contract is signed
e.b: Your licence is issued once the contract is signed. You receive a Digital License Credential (DLC) carrying a notarized e-signature, plus a co-branded "TIS × authoritative institution" Verified License Badge .
e.zb: 合約簽署後即簽發授權。交付含公證電子簽章的數位授權憑證（DLC），以及「TIS × 權威機構」聯名授權認證標章。

e.b: The badge embeds a unique license number and QR code. Print it on international booth signage, proposals, your website footer, or product packaging.
e.zb: 標章內嵌獨一授權編號與 QR Code，2 秒線上即時驗證。可印於國際展位、提案書、官網 Footer 或產品外包裝。

e.b: Filing patents is slow and expensive , and an IP hire is overhead. A TIS patent bundle is a subscription on 3 / 6 / 12 / 24-month terms. Pricing on request.
e.zt: 專利授權列為營運支出
e.zb: 自行申請專利耗時又昂貴，專職 IP 人力是固定開銷。專利包採訂閱制，期別 3 / 6 / 12 / 24 個月。價格請洽詢。

e.b: Buyers ask about your patent position before they order. Without an answer, the order waits.
e.zt: 補專利缺口有三條路，只有一條為出口商打造。
e.zb: 買家下單前會先問你的專利佈局；答不出來，訂單就得等。

e.zb: 買到的是薪水，不是防護。

e.b: A non-exclusive licence to 30 patents, issued to your company. Pricing on request.
e.zb: 以貴公司名義簽發、涵蓋 30 件專利的非專屬授權。價格請洽詢。

e.b: Pay only for the market you actually need.
e.zb: 只為你真正需要的市場付費。

e.b: Matched to where your product actually competes.

e.zb: 產品與市場描述越具體，AI 專利推薦就越貼近你實際的海外風險。

e.b: One patent isn't a position — it's a target : the day it issues, rivals know which claim to design around. Thirty is the fewest that truly deters; more is just an arms race, adding cost for nothing.
e.zt: 為什麼是 30 件，不是 1 件
e.zb: 1 件不是佈局，是被告的標靶：發證當下，對手就知道要繞開哪一條請求項。30 件是真正能嚇阻的最小數字，再多只是軍備競賽，徒增成本。

e.b: 30 patents across all 5 tiers. S and A are the strategic top tier that go on offense ; B, C and D blanket the field around them — quality and quantity in one bundle.
e.zb: 30 件橫跨 5 個評級：5 S、6 A、9 B、6 C、4 D。S、A 屬頂級戰略、能打的強項，B、C、D 補足數量，有質有量兼備。

e.b: Swap any pick for a same-tier alternate — no extra cost , no review wait.
e.zb: 同級專利自選替換，不加價、無等審。

e.b: Bundle, term and coverage on one page — no line-item surprises at signing.
e.zb: 專利包、期限、涵蓋範圍一頁看清，簽約時沒有隱藏費用。

e.b: Maintenance, repair, spares, field service and warranty across Taiwan, through an island-wide service partner, under one contract.

e.zb: 透過全台服務夥伴，以一份合約涵蓋維護、維修、備品、現場服務與保固。

e.t: Every week without a local sustainment partner is a week of lead-time risk, warranty exposure and readiness questions from your customer.
e.b: You have systems fielded in Taiwan, or an order that will put them there.
e.zt: 沒有在地維運夥伴的每一週，都是交期風險、保固曝險，以及客戶對妥善率的追問。
e.zb: 您已有系統部署在台灣，或即將有訂單把系統帶到這裡。

e.t: Local MRO capacity that keeps your contracts on track.

e.b: Sites across the island, certified technicians and local spares mean repairs happen close to where your systems operate. Nothing ships back to the factory, so you skip the round-trip freight and export paperwork, and downtime is shorter. In
e.zt: 在台灣修好，系統隨時可用

e.t: ITAR compliance, covered on our side

e.zb: 國防品項維修需要美方核准的 TAA，由原廠提出申請。台灣端的人員名單與審查、場地與資料管制、合約附件，都由 TIS 備齊，減少您的往返補件；未獲核准前，我們不接觸任何國防品項。

e.t: How a service partner becomes UV-grade
